title: boardwise device library sample — one differential case input
description: A declared sample of .epru record text. The input carries no expected projection: both runners derive boardwise.device-library/1 from the text. No pinKey: a DEVICE document is addressed by its own uuid, and nothing in its META is keyed by an element handle.

text.x-meaning: The .epru record stream verbatim: {envelope}||{body}| lines, terminator optional on the last line.
